outcome: Proportion of patients with sustained severe-range BP (SBP ≥160 mm Hg or DBP ≥110 mm Hg)
cohort: 25 postpartum patients with preeclampsia with severe features were included in this pilot study.
finding: Continuous BP monitoring detected sustained severe-range blood pressure in a significantly higher proportion of postpartum patients with preeclampsia with severe features compared to intermittent monitoring.
